title: Slug minted (POST /api/tournaments, 201)
description: Reader: OpenPairings, whose snapshots for this tournament must then carry exactly this tournament.slug. Refusals: 401 unauthorized; 403 installation_key_required, installation_suspended, installation_revoked, address_blocked, tournament_limit (with limit); 429 rate_limited; 503 publishing_paused, storage_low.

slug.description: Twelve characters the server chose: 9 random bytes, base64url, no padding.
